01
Our way

It’s more than boxing.
It’s who we are.

MYC Boxing isn’t just a gym. It’s where Masterton’s young people learn how to train, how to think, how to carry themselves — and how to treat others.

205 Chapel St · Masterton

Masterton Young Citizens Boxing Club has been building strong young people in the Wairarapa for years — in the ring and out of it. Kids as young as 8 train alongside teenagers and adults, all learning the same thing: show up, work hard, respect each other.

The club trains at 205 Chapel Street, Masterton, with classes for juniors, seniors and ladies — plus group training, one-to-one sessions and fighter training on request.

Why MYC

Train hard. Stay focused.

What makes MYC different isn’t the bags or the ring — it’s what the club stands for.

— 01

Built for young people

MYC exists for Masterton’s youth first. Kids learn boxing, discipline and respect — and carry it into school and life.

— 02

One team, one family

Everyone trains together, supports each other and represents the club the right way. When you join MYC, you join a family.

— 03

Real progress

From first-timers to fighters, every member improves — fitter, sharper, more confident — session by session.
